scope: Seven-to-six boundary existence, minimum and extremal shapes, all-size minimum-width inverse, and stated continuation bounds. Unrestricted E remains active.
conclusion: A genuine seven-to-six boundary with a unique ternary seed first occurs at nine ordinary sites and 21 distinctions. At all finite sizes with only the first two unary additions making three outputs, distances through four determine every junction, allowed state and next join against arbitrary reachable rivals. This is sharp for a triple. The source may shrink again to five.
reader_input: The current named or anonymously permuted pair table and optionally a marked triple, with the fixed serial law. No source history, count profile or places are supplied.
primary_class: Size-independent counting and identification theorems with a finite fixed-point proof and literal witnesses.
uniform_claims: Every ordinary shore of three or more sites with boundary at most six in a single-ternary source has at least nine sites. The first width is 21 and the first proper width is 23.

Every finite single-ternary source at minimum width 2n+3 for n >= 3 is identified up to its actual incidence, states and all legal next groups by distances through four, against arbitrary reachable mixed rivals.

In that class there are at most two shrinking joins, no legal triple after the second, and no pair of legal complementary triples on six loose distinctions. An opposing marked triple under clipping through three is realized at width 25.
At every input-output pair of a nonseed junction under the serial law, the bond distance is exactly the physical arity minus one.

Under all mixed continuations of the displayed width-21 construction the original nine equations remain forced through distance four and their sum remains a minimal six-bit equation. The displayed three-pair certificate permanently excludes this bond as a physical site following two named binary additions.
There are marked interior continuations with arbitrarily many simultaneous legal triples and separate families with arbitrarily many nested recognizably non-site six-bit bonds.
postdesign: Minimum-width whole-class closure, the second shrinking join and the exact ring-algorithm transposition were investigated after the initial literal constructions. All-size conclusions have separate counting, rank and finite fixed-point arguments.
ring_comparison: On a serial source with two shrinking joins the published baseline R3 confuses the five loose exterior bits for a junction under a single renaming, even on all unpooled distances. This applies outside its original ring cohort.
unrestricted_obligation: Unrestricted full-table three-parent invariance remains open. A single-ternary opposing pair must use at least three three-output additions on each side. At exactly three, forcing the source equations suffices by the rank bound.
validation_class: V1. Distinct same-task mathematical investigations, exhaustive finite closure checked against literal moves, deterministic table and permutation replays. Separate referee review outstanding.
assumptions: G1 strengthened within this family. A97 remains under challenge. No new assumptions or goal statements.
